global.headerGreeting: Good to see you, {name}. I've been keeping things moving.
global.headerGreetingAnon: Good to see you. I've been keeping things moving.
global.autonomyToggleLabel: How much I do on my own: {tierLabel}
global.wardrobeHint: Tap my outfit or my hair — everything I wear is in the store.
global.workingNow: I'm working on something for you right now.
global.restingNow: I've paused. Nothing moves until you say the word.

greetings.buildersHallWelcome: Welcome back to the Hill, {name}. Take your time — I'm right here.
greetings.dailyWelcome: Good to have you, {name}. Let's take today one move at a time.
greetings.firstVisit: Welcome. I'm Frassy. Before anything else, let me learn what you're building.
greetings.returning: Good to see you again, {name}. Nothing was lost while you were away.

hero.heroFrassyNote: {moveName} is finished and waiting on your word.
hero.heroFrassyNote_Beginner: I finished your {moveName}, {name}. Everything's connected and tested. Say yes and I'll make it live for you — no stress.
hero.heroFrassyNote_Learner: I finished your {moveName} and left notes so you can see exactly what I did. Want me to walk you through it?
hero.heroFrassyNote_Intermediate: {moveName} is built and ready. Look it over, change anything you want, then send it live.
hero.heroFrassyNote_Advanced: {moveName} is built to your spec, tested end to end and ready to launch. Full detail is open below.
hero.heroWhyBuilt: Why I built it this way: {insight}

queue.sectionBlurbActive: Work I finished for you. Nothing goes live until you say so.
queue.sectionBlurbPaused: I've paused new builds, love. Anything already finished still waits here for your word.
queue.empty: Nothing waiting on you right now, {name}. I'm still building in the background — come back a little later.
queue.emptyAnon: Nothing waiting on you right now. I'm still building in the background — come back a little later.
queue.yourMovesBlurb: The moves you're running yourself. Same cards as your Daily — one place, one truth.

confirmations.launched: Beautiful. I'll take it from here.
confirmations.changesRequested: Got your note, love. I'm rebuilding the piece you asked for — I'll bring it back when it's ready.
confirmations.shelved: Shelved, not lost. It stays yours, exactly as it is, until you want it again.
confirmations.approved: Approved. I'm proud of how this one came out.

trouble.generic: Hmm, this one giving a little trouble. Let me sort it out and try again.
trouble.network: The line went quiet for a second. Nothing you did was lost — try once more when you're ready.
trouble.notAllowed: I'm not able to do that one from here. I can point you to someone on the team who can.
trouble.money: I couldn't complete that payment step, and I won't guess with your money. Please check the details and try again.
trouble.security: For your protection I stopped there. Please sign in again to continue.

empty.generic: Nothing here yet, and that's fine — here's where we start.
empty.vault: Your Vault is still quiet. The first thing you keep here starts your record.
empty.journal: No entries yet. The first line you write is the beginning of the story.

loading.generic: One moment — I'm gathering this for you.
loading.thinking: Let me think this through properly.
loading.building: I'm building it now. I'll tell you the moment it's done.

welcome.tierIntro: How you'd like to be welcomed — right now it's {styleName}
welcome.tierPlain: Here's what that means: this choice lives in your Daily settings, and I greet you this way every morning until you change it.

freedom.progress: {pct}% of the way to your freedom number.

ariaLiveAnnouncement.Error: Something went wrong. I've left everything exactly as it was.

accessibility.avatarOutfit: See what I'm wearing in the store
accessibility.avatarHair: See my hair style in the store
